description: This file defines the class writeexcel_workbook, which is a PHP port of the Perl Spreadsheet::WriteExcel package. It manages the creation and finalization of Excel workbooks, encompassing worksheet management, formatting, palette configuration, and BIFF record assembly for Excel file generation.

classes.name: writeexcel_workbook
classes.description: A PHP class that represents an Excel workbook, providing methods for creation, sheet management, formatting, palette configuration, and internal BIFF record handling for generating Excel files compatible with BIFF format.

methods.name: writeexcel_workbook
methods.description: Constructor; initializes a new workbook object with specified filename, sets default properties, and prepares internal structures for Excel file creation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes the workbook creation process by gathering all worksheet data, writing workbook globals, and storing the entire workbook as an OLE file.

methods.name: sheets
methods.description: Returns an array reference of all worksheet objects associated with this workbook.

methods.name: addworksheet
methods.description: Adds a new worksheet with an optional name, ensuring name uniqueness and length constraints, and returns the worksheet object.

methods.name: addformat
methods.description: Creates and adds a new cell format to the workbook, optionally initialized with properties, and returns the format object.

methods.name: set_1904
methods.description: Sets the date system flag; 0 for 1900-based, 1 for 1904-based date system.

methods.name: get_1904
methods.description: Retrieves the current date system flag (0 or 1).

methods.name: set_custom_color
methods.description: Modifies a color in the palette, indexed between 8 and 64, to custom RGB values.

methods.name: set_palette_xl97
methods.description: Sets the color palette to the Excel 97+ default palette.

methods.name: set_palette_xl5
methods.description: Sets the color palette to the Excel 5 default palette.

methods.name: _store_workbook
methods.description: Assembles all worksheet data, writes BIFF records for workbook globals, and stores the file in an OLE container.

methods.name: _store_OLE_file
methods.description: Stores the assembled workbook data into an OLE container file for output.

methods.name: _calc_sheet_offsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets for worksheet data within the BIFF stream.

methods.name: _store_all_fonts
methods.description: Writes all font records required by the workbook, including defaults and custom formats.

methods.name: _store_all_num_formats
methods.description: Writes custom numerical format records for non-standard formats used in cell formats.

methods.name: _store_all_xfs
methods.description: Outputs all XF (eXtended Format) records for cell and style formatting.

methods.name: _store_all_styles
methods.description: Writes style records for the workbook.

methods.name: _store_externs
methods.description: Records external sheet references utilized in print areas and repeat rows/columns.

methods.name: _store_names
methods.description: Defines named ranges for print areas and repeat rows/columns.

methods.name: _store_window1
methods.description: Creates the WINDOW1 BIFF record, which controls window display options.

methods.name: _store_boundsheet
methods.description: Stores a BOUNDSHEET BIFF record for each worksheet, indicating its position in the file.

methods.name: _store_style
methods.description: Stores style records.

methods.name: _store_num_format
methods.description: Creates a FORMAT record for a custom numeric format.

methods.name: _store_1904
methods.description: Writes a BIFF record indicating the date system used (1900 or 1904).

methods.name: _store_externcount
methods.description: Records the number of external sheet references.

methods.name: _store_externsheet
methods.description: Creates an EXTERNSHEET BIFF record for external sheet references.

methods.name: _store_name_short
methods.description: Stores a short NAME record for print areas or repeat rows/columns with minimal data.

methods.name: _store_name_long
methods.description: Stores a detailed NAME record when print areas or repeats encompass multiple rows or columns.

methods.name: _store_palette
methods.description: Stores the color palette as a BIFF PALETTE record.
